metadata.name: Developer Handoff
metadata.description: Implementation-ready output for engineering services and development teams.

styleRules: Use exact identifiers, paths and contract names when verified.
Separate implementation instructions from completed work.
Show runnable commands and expected evidence where appropriate.
Call out compatibility and migration concerns.

hostProjectionHints.claude-code: Generate a selectable output-style projection when supported.
hostProjectionHints.vscode: Inject this profile through the host adapter as presentation context.
hostProjectionHints.cursor: Project as agent or rule presentation instructions.
hostProjectionHints.codex: Project as scoped instructions; do not assume a native output-style selector.
